text: 中国央行公开市场开展200亿元7天期逆回购操作，操作利率1.40%，持平上日。中国央行开展3330亿元隔夜逆回购操作。今日5985亿元逆回购到期。中国央行公开市场本周净投放13265亿元。
text_en: The PBOC conducted 20 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repos at an interest rate of 1.40%, unchanged from the prior day. The PBOC conducted 333 billion yuan of overnight reverse repos. A total of 598.5 billion yuan of reverse repos mature today. The PBOC injected a net 1.3265 trillion yuan over the week in open market operations.
